title: Morsel
tagline: Clear the maze. Four things in it would rather you did not.
description: A maze full of crumbs and four hunters that want you out of it. Eat every crumb to finish the maze; the hunters chase, and each one is looking for you differently — one comes straight at you, one cuts you off, one keeps its distance until it does not. The four bright morsels in the corners turn the tables for a few seconds and send them running. Every maze cleared makes them quicker and their retreat shorter.
author: HexCave
howToPlay: Arrows or a swipe to move. You keep going until a wall stops you.
Eat every crumb to clear the maze. The hunters chase, each in its own way.
A bright morsel makes them run from you — for a few seconds, and less each maze.
goal: Clear every crumb from the maze. Three lives, and the hunters get faster each time you do.
